database.initialization: On backend startup, migrate older databases (PRAGMA user_version), then create missing tables and seed the default admin when there are no users.

users.purpose: Application accounts. Users register themselves or are created by an administrator.
constraints: username: 3-32 letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_', unique ignoring case
at least one administrator must always exist

sessions.purpose: Login sessions; the token is sent in the HttpOnly pm_session cookie.
constraints: changing or resetting a password deletes the user's sessions

boards.purpose: Kanban boards; a user owns any number of them.
constraints: a user keeps at least one board
new boards start with the five default columns

columns.purpose: Board stages; they can be added, renamed and removed when empty.
constraints: UNIQUE(board_id, position) keeps column order deterministic
UNIQUE(board_id, id) keeps column identifiers scoped to a board
a board keeps at least one column

cards.purpose: Cards displayed inside a board column.
constraints: UNIQUE(column_id, position) keeps card order deterministic
A card must reference a column belonging to the same board

delete_behavior.user: CASCADE sessions, boards, columns, and cards
delete_behavior.board: Delete its cards, then CASCADE columns
delete_behavior.column: RESTRICT while cards exist; move or delete cards before removing a column

migrations.1_to_2: Add users.is_admin (user-1 becomes admin), the sessions table, cards.priority and cards.due_date; rebuild boards without UNIQUE(user_id) so users can own several boards.

user.storage: Store only a password hash in the database; the literal password is used only by the seed path.

api_mapping.board_response: Return columns ordered by position, with cards nested in each column ordered by position.
api_mapping.board_list: Return the user's boards ordered by creation, each with its card count.
api_mapping.create_card: Insert cards with the next position for the selected column.
api_mapping.update_card: Partial update: only fields sent change; a null due_date clears it.
api_mapping.move_card: Update column_id and normalize positions in the source and destination columns.
api_mapping.delete_card: Delete the card and normalize positions in its column.
api_mapping.delete_column: Only when empty; renumber the remaining column positions.

implementation_notes: Use parameterized SQL for all queries.
Use transactions for moves and other operations affecting more than one row.
Every board, column and card query is scoped by the signed-in user's board id; another user's ids return 404.
Do not store the frontend cardIds array; derive ordering from cards.column_id and cards.position.
